practice.input: Listen to one complete, naturally paced everyday exchange with optional target script and Korean meaning; replay or shadow only by learner choice.
practice.output: Identify the practical change or choice, then summarize or adapt one useful response in the learner's own words.
practice.dings: One start cue and one end cue per finished card

cards.title: A Later Haircut
cards.situation: At a salon, a stylist asks a customer to move his next haircut appointment.
cards.situationKo: 미용실에서 디자이너가 손님에게 다음번 예약 시간을 바꿀 수 있는지 묻습니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 제안받은 시간이 어려울 때 다른 시간을 묻고 담당자를 확인해요.
cards.learnerInput: An in-person conversation at the salon proposing three o'clock instead of four for the next haircut.
cards.expectedOutput: Politely reject the proposed time, ask about five, and confirm that the same stylist will do the haircut.
cards.artworkBrief: In-person salon scene: female stylist Mia and customer Noah discuss his future haircut appointment beside an appointment book. No phone call or embedded text.

lines.speaker: mia
lines.en: For your next haircut, could you come at three instead of four?
lines.ko: 다음번 머리 자르러 오실 때, 네 시 대신 세 시에 오실 수 있을까요?

lines.speaker: noah
lines.en: I can't get there by three. Is five still open?
lines.ko: 세 시까지는 못 가요. 다섯 시는 아직 가능할까요?

lines.speaker: mia
lines.en: Let me check. Yes, I can move you to five.
lines.ko: 확인해 볼게요. 네, 다섯 시로 옮겨 드릴 수 있어요.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.en: Great. Will you still be doing my haircut?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 그때도 선생님이 머리 잘라 주시는 거죠?

lines.speaker: mia
lines.en: Yep, it'll still be me. I'll send you a confirmation.
lines.ko: 네, 그때도 제가 해 드릴 거예요. 변경 확인 문자 보내 드릴게요.

lines.speaker: noah
lines.en: Thanks. I'll see you at five.
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 다섯 시에 뵐게요.

variationPrompt.en: Five is also full. As Mia, offer tomorrow morning and ask whether that works.
variationPrompt.ko: 다섯 시도 예약이 찼어요. 미아가 되어 내일 오전을 제안하고 괜찮은지 물어보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: Five is full too. Would tomorrow morning work for you?

cards.title: Trying the Next Size
cards.situation: A customer is comparing shoe sizes in a store.
cards.situationKo: 신발 가게에서 손님이 신어 본 신발의 크기를 비교합니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 신발이 어디가 끼는지 설명하고 한 치수 큰 신발을 부탁해요.
cards.learnerInput: A pair of shoes that feels tight around the toes.
cards.expectedOutput: Describe the fit and ask to compare the next size.
cards.artworkBrief: Seated customer trying shoes while a clerk brings a second box; show the physical question of fit, with no printed brand.

lines.speaker: zoe
lines.en: How do those feel?
lines.ko: 신어 보시니까 어떠세요?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.en: A little tight, especially around my toes.
lines.ko: 발가락 쪽이 좀 끼네요.

lines.speaker: zoe
lines.en: Want me to bring the next size up?
lines.ko: 한 치수 큰 걸 가져다드릴까요?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.en: Yes, please. I'd like to compare them.
lines.ko: 네, 두 치수 다 신어 보고 비교해 볼게요.

lines.speaker: zoe
lines.en: Sure. Keep that pair on while I get it.
lines.ko: 네. 제가 가져오는 동안 그 신발 신고 계세요.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.en: Thanks. I'm not in a hurry.
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 천천히 보셔도 돼요.

variationPrompt.en: The larger pair slips at the heel. Tell Zoe what changed and ask for another option.
variationPrompt.ko: 큰 신발은 뒤꿈치가 벗겨져요. 어떤 점이 달라졌는지 말하고 다른 신발을 물어보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: The bigger pair slips at the heel. Do you have another style I could try?

cards.title: The Full Bike Rack
cards.situation: Friends arrive at a sports center and the bike rack by the entrance is full.
cards.situationKo: 친구 두 명이 운동센터에 도착했는데 정문 옆 자전거 거치대가 꽉 차 있습니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 거치할 다른 곳을 찾고 비를 피할 수 있는지 확인해요.
cards.learnerInput: A full rack near the front door and a possible second rack behind the building.
cards.expectedOutput: Explain the problem, ask whether the alternative is covered, and agree where to meet.
cards.artworkBrief: Two friends with bicycles beside a full front rack; a second covered rack near a side door, with no branded building sign. Do not block a sidewalk or exit.

speakers.role: friend familiar with the sports center

lines.speaker: luis
lines.en: Did you find a spot for your bike?
lines.ko: 자전거 세울 자리 찾았어?

lines.speaker: ava
lines.en: No, the rack by the front door is full.
lines.ko: 아니, 정문 옆 자전거 거치대가 꽉 찼어.

lines.speaker: luis
lines.en: There's another one behind the building.
lines.ko: 건물 뒤에도 하나 있어.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.en: Is it covered? It might rain.
lines.ko: 지붕은 있어? 비 올 것 같은데.

lines.speaker: luis
lines.en: Yep, and there's a side door right next to it.
lines.ko: 응. 바로 옆에 옆문도 있어.

lines.speaker: ava
lines.en: Great. I'll lock it there and meet you inside.
lines.ko: 좋아. 거기에 잠그고 안에서 만나자.

variationPrompt.en: The covered rack is also full. As Luis, suggest a safe third place or ask at the front desk.
variationPrompt.ko: 지붕 있는 거치대도 꽉 찼어요. 루이스가 되어 안전한 다른 장소를 제안하거나 안내 데스크에 물어보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: That rack's full too. Let's ask at the front desk where we can park them.

cards.title: The Temporary Bus Stop
cards.situation: A rider finds that a fictional bus has moved to a temporary stop during sidewalk work.
cards.situationKo: 인도 공사 때문에 버스의 임시 정류장이 길 건너편으로 옮겨졌습니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 버스가 어디에 서는지 묻고 건너갈 위치를 확인해요.
cards.learnerInput: The usual side of the street has no bus stop this week.
cards.expectedOutput: Ask for the temporary stop, a landmark, and the correct crossing point.
cards.artworkBrief: Fictional city corner with a crossing light and original unbranded bus-stop sign across the street. Do not depict a real route or transit authority.

lines.speaker: jamie
lines.en: Excuse me, does the eight still stop on this side?
lines.ko: 실례합니다. 8번 버스가 아직 이쪽에 서나요?

lines.speaker: pat
lines.en: Not this week. They're fixing the sidewalk here.
lines.ko: 이번 주는 아니에요. 여기 인도 공사 중이거든요.

lines.speaker: jamie
lines.en: Oh, where's the temporary stop?
lines.ko: 아, 임시 정류장은 어디예요?

lines.speaker: pat
lines.en: Across the street, just past the bank.
lines.ko: 길 건너 은행 조금 지나면 있어요.

lines.speaker: jamie
lines.en: Thanks. Should I cross at this light?
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 여기 신호등에서 건너면 되나요?

lines.speaker: pat
lines.en: Yes. Look for the yellow bus sign.
lines.ko: 네. 노란 버스 표지판 보이실 거예요.

variationPrompt.en: The bank is closed and hard to spot. As Pat, give a different visible landmark.
variationPrompt.ko: 은행이 문을 닫아 눈에 잘 띄지 않아요. 팻이 되어 다른 눈에 띄는 건물을 알려 주세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: It's across the street, next to the small grocery store.

cards.title: The Sold-Out Showing
cards.situation: The movie friends planned to see has sold out, so they compare two alternatives.
cards.situationKo: 보려고 했던 영화가 매진되어 친구 두 명이 다른 선택지를 고릅니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 매진된 영화 대신 늦은 상영이나 다른 영화를 비교해 선택해요.
cards.learnerInput: The six o'clock showing is sold out; another showing and another movie are available.
cards.expectedOutput: Compare waiting with changing the film, state a preference, and make a plan.
cards.artworkBrief: Two friends studying a fictional showtime board in a theater lobby; no real film title, poster, or brand.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.en: Looks like the six o'clock movie is sold out.
lines.ko: 여섯 시 영화는 매진됐나 봐.

lines.speaker: dani
lines.en: There's another showing at seven-thirty.
lines.ko: 일곱 시 반 상영은 있네.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.en: That's pretty late. Is a different movie starting sooner?
lines.ko: 그건 좀 늦다. 더 일찍 시작하는 다른 영화는 없어?

lines.speaker: dani
lines.en: The comedy starts at six-fifteen.
lines.ko: 코미디 영화는 여섯 시 십오 분에 시작해.

lines.speaker: alex
lines.en: I'd rather see that than wait around.
lines.ko: 기다리느니 그걸 보는 게 낫겠다.

lines.speaker: dani
lines.en: Me too. I'll get us two tickets.
lines.ko: 나도. 내가 표 두 장 살게.

variationPrompt.en: The comedy has only one seat left. As Dani, suggest another option without ending the outing.
variationPrompt.ko: 코미디 영화도 한 자리만 남았어요. 다니가 되어 다른 방법을 제안해 보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: Only one seat is left. Want to see the later movie and get a snack first?

cards.title: The Package Next Door
cards.situation: A neighbor brings over a parcel left at the wrong apartment door.
cards.situationKo: 이웃집 앞에 잘못 놓인 택배를 원래 받을 사람에게 가져다줍니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 잘못 배달된 택배를 확인하고 상자 상태를 짚어 줘요.
cards.learnerInput: An unopened parcel with a hard-to-read label and a slightly bent corner.
cards.expectedOutput: Identify the mix-up, ask about damage, and decide to inspect the parcel.
cards.artworkBrief: Apartment hallway, one unopened box with a slightly bent corner, no legible personal information or real address.

lines.speaker: erin
lines.en: Hi, is this your package? It was outside my door.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이거 혹시 댁으로 온 택배인가요? 저희 집 앞에 놓여 있었어요.

lines.speaker: mateo
lines.en: It is. They must have mixed up our apartment numbers.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 집 호수를 잘못 본 모양이네요.

lines.speaker: erin
lines.en: I didn't open it. The label was a little hard to read.
lines.ko: 뜯지는 않았어요. 송장 글씨가 좀 흐릿하더라고요.

lines.speaker: mateo
lines.en: No worries. Is the box damaged?
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 상자는 안 망가졌나요?

lines.speaker: erin
lines.en: Just one corner. You might want to check what's inside.
lines.ko: 모서리 한쪽만 조금 구겨졌어요. 내용물 한번 확인해 보세요.

lines.speaker: mateo
lines.en: I will. Thanks for bringing it over.
lines.ko: 그럴게요. 가져다주셔서 고마워요.

variationPrompt.en: The package is for another floor. As Erin, explain where it was found and ask if Mateo knows the correct neighbor.
variationPrompt.ko: 택배가 다른 층 사람 것이에요. 에린이 되어 어디서 찾았는지 설명하고 받는 사람을 아는지 물어보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: It was outside my door, but the label says another floor. Do you know who lives there?

cards.title: A Working Outlet
cards.situation: Two classmates need to move library seats because an outlet does not work.
cards.situationKo: 도서관 자리 근처 콘센트가 고장 나서 친구들이 자리를 옮기려 합니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 현재 자리의 문제를 말하고 콘센트가 있는 자리로 옮겨요.
cards.learnerInput: A phone battery is low; the closest outlet is broken and a window table is free.
cards.expectedOutput: Explain why the current seat will not work and propose a practical move.
cards.artworkBrief: Quiet library table with unplugged phone, books and bags; free table by window; no brand logos or phone UI text.

lines.speaker: kim
lines.en: My phone's almost dead. Is there an outlet near this table?
lines.ko: 휴대폰 배터리가 거의 다 됐어. 이 자리 근처에 콘센트 있어?

lines.speaker: jay
lines.en: There's one behind us, but it doesn't work.
lines.ko: 우리 뒤에 하나 있는데, 고장 났어.

lines.speaker: kim
lines.en: Could we move to the table by the window?
lines.ko: 창가 자리로 옮길까?

lines.speaker: jay
lines.en: Sure, it's empty. I'll grab our books.
lines.ko: 좋아, 비어 있네. 내가 책 챙길게.

lines.speaker: kim
lines.en: Thanks. I'll take the bags.
lines.ko: 고마워. 가방은 내가 들게.

lines.speaker: jay
lines.en: Great. Let's go before someone else takes it.
lines.ko: 좋아. 다른 사람이 앉기 전에 가자.

variationPrompt.en: The window table is taken. As Jay, suggest another way to charge the phone without leaving belongings unattended.
variationPrompt.ko: 창가 자리에도 사람이 앉아 있어요. 제이가 되어 짐을 두고 가지 않으면서 충전할 방법을 제안하세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: That table's taken. Let's ask at the desk if there's another outlet.

cards.title: The Study Room Mix-Up
cards.situation: A reserved study room is still occupied, and the librarian offers another available room.
cards.situationKo: 예약한 공부방을 다른 사람이 쓰고 있어 사서가 다른 방을 안내합니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 예약한 방을 쓸 수 없을 때 필요한 시간을 말하고 다른 방을 찾아요.
cards.learnerInput: A two o'clock room reservation is delayed; a smaller room is free until three.
cards.expectedOutput: Explain the reservation problem, mention the time needed, accept another room and locate it.
cards.artworkBrief: Library front desk with room door in background; neutral reservation screen without personal data.

lines.speaker: robin
lines.en: I reserved the study room for two o'clock, but someone is still inside.
lines.ko: 두 시에 공부방을 예약했는데 아직 다른 분이 쓰고 계세요.

lines.speaker: casey
lines.en: Sorry about that. Let me see when they'll finish.
lines.ko: 죄송해요. 언제 끝나는지 확인해 볼게요.

lines.speaker: robin
lines.en: I only need half an hour. Is another room free?
lines.ko: 저는 30분만 쓰면 돼요. 다른 방은 비어 있나요?

lines.speaker: casey
lines.en: Yes, the small room is open until three.
lines.ko: 네, 작은 방은 세 시까지 비어 있어요.

lines.speaker: robin
lines.en: That works. Is it on this floor?
lines.ko: 그럼 그 방 쓰면 되겠네요. 같은 층에 있나요?

lines.speaker: casey
lines.en: Yes, right behind the front desk.
lines.ko: 네, 안내 데스크 바로 뒤에 있어요.

variationPrompt.en: The small room is not free after all. As Casey, offer a wait time or a quieter open table.
variationPrompt.ko: 작은 방도 비어 있지 않아요. 케이시가 되어 기다릴 시간이나 조용한 열린 자리를 제안하세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: I'm sorry, that room's taken too. There's a quiet table upstairs if that works.

cards.title: Picking Up the Phone
cards.situation: A customer arrives for a repaired phone, but the final screen check is not finished.
cards.situationKo: 수리한 휴대폰을 찾으러 갔지만 새 화면의 마지막 점검이 아직 끝나지 않았습니다.
cards.descriptionKo: 예상보다 늦어진 수리 상태를 듣고 다시 올 시간과 연락 방법을 정해요.
cards.learnerInput: The repaired phone needs one final check, while the customer needs it this afternoon.
cards.expectedOutput: Ask for a realistic pickup time and request a message at the work number already on file.
cards.artworkBrief: Repair-shop counter with phone awaiting final check and generic form; no legible personal data or real company brand.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.en: Hi, I'm here to pick up my phone. The name is Jordan Lee.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 휴대폰 찾으러 왔어요. 조던 리로 맡겼습니다.

lines.speaker: taylor
lines.en: We have it, but the new screen still needs one more check.
lines.ko: 네, 맡기신 휴대폰 있어요. 새 화면을 한 번 더 점검해야 해요.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.en: Oh, I need it this afternoon. When should I come back?
lines.ko: 아, 오늘 오후에 써야 하는데요. 언제 다시 오면 될까요?

lines.speaker: taylor
lines.en: After one should be safe. We can text you if it's ready earlier.
lines.ko: 한 시 이후에 오시면 될 것 같아요. 더 일찍 끝나면 문자 드릴게요.

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.en: Great. Please text my work cell; it's on the form.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 신청서에 적어 둔 회사 휴대폰 번호로 문자 주세요.

lines.speaker: taylor
lines.en: Got it. I'll text you as soon as it's ready.
lines.ko: 네, 다 되면 바로 그 번호로 문자 드릴게요.

variationPrompt.en: The check fails and repair will take another day. As Taylor, explain the delay briefly and offer to call when the phone is ready.
variationPrompt.ko: 점검에서 문제가 발견돼 하루 더 걸립니다. 테일러가 되어 상황을 짧게 설명하고 완료되면 전화하겠다고 제안하세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: The screen needs another day. I'm sorry about the delay. Can I call you when it's ready?
